text: Bonds is a brand of HanesBrands, which the Canadian listed apparel maker Gildan Activewear acquired on 1 December 2025.
short: Bonds is a HanesBrands brand, acquired by Gildan.

source.name: Ragtrader: Bonds' parent company HanesBrands acquired
source.quote: HanesBrands Inc., the parent company of Australian brands Bonds, Sheridan and Berlei, has been acquired by Canadian apparel business Gildan Activewear Inc.

additionalSources.name: Gildan: Gildan acquires HanesBrands - FAQ
additionalSources.quote: The transaction was finalized on December 1, 2025
